title: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc 2027 Race Regulations — Equipment and Penalties
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc
claims: If runners choose to take hiking poles, they must carry them for the entire duration of the race; it is forbidden to start without poles and get them during the course of the race, and no poles are authorized in the spare bags.
The use of poles may be prohibited in certain areas marked by specific signs along the course, for safety or environmental reasons.
For UTMB, CCC and TDS 100M races, use of poles not carried from the start or abandonment of poles during the race draws a 1-hour penalty; for OCC, MCC and ETC races it draws a 30-minute penalty.

Proven dangerous behavior such as poles with uncovered tips oriented towards runners or spectators, or dangerous overtaking, draws a 15-minute penalty in the 100M races and a 10-minute penalty in the OCC/MCC/ETC races.
